note: Each defect is tied to the exact SHA it was observed on. Fixes are proposed as patches for R01 (or the owning role); R10 does not edit product files. Severity: critical (data loss / unauthorized publication / secret exposure in normal use), high, medium, low.

defects.title: Runtime SQLite (.runtime/) is neither git-ignored nor docker-ignored
defects.repro: In a clean checkout of b2cb2e0: mkdir .runtime && touch .runtime/civic.sqlite3 .runtime/civic.sqlite3-wal && git status --porcelain --ignored .runtime
defects.expected: CONTRACT §3: 'Хранилище SQLite в .runtime/ … без раздачи файла и без коммита DB'; COMMON: не коммитить SQLite с пользователями/private обращения. Status should be '!! .runtime/' (ignored).
defects.actual: '?? .runtime/' (untracked, not ignored): git add . / -A would commit civic_users.password_hash, sessions and private feedback. Dockerfile 'COPY . .' with .dockerignore lacking .runtime would bake the DB into an image. R02 db.py docstring states the folder 'игнорируется Git', which is not true on any pushed branch.
defects.patch: research/round-11-results/R10/patches/R01-gitignore-runtime.patch (git apply --check OK on b2cb2e0; after applying, status is '!! .runtime/')

defects.title: R07 /scenarios/compare: non-string graph_id raises TypeError (unhashable) -> HTTP 500 instead of 4xx
defects.repro: cd <worktree d77ec45> && python3 -I -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from engine.civic_scenarios import http as h; h.handle('POST','/api/civic/v1/scenarios/compare',None,{'graph_id':['x']})"  -> TypeError: unhashable type: 'list' (registry.load_graph: _cache.get(graph_id) before the type check in _entry). Full fuzz: tests/civic/R10/standalone/r07_typefuzz.py -> 5/210 probes escape (graph_id = [], {}, [1], [None], {'a':1}).
defects.expected: CONTRACT §2: validation errors 400/422 as JSON envelope; 'Ошибки — JSON, не traceback/HTML'. R07 http.handle documents ScenarioError -> {ok:false,error}.
defects.actual: Exception escapes http.handle; behind R01 CivicGateway it becomes 500 'internal' with a logged stack trace; standalone devserver behaviour depends on its own catch-all.
defects.patch: research/round-11-results/R10/patches/R07-graph-id-type.patch (type check before cache lookup; with it 0/210 probes escape, graph_id=['x'] -> 404 unknown_graph like other unknown ids)

observations.title: Public history of a re-published date change carries the publish reason, not the editor's update reason
observations.repro: create draft -> publish(reason A) -> update(changes.schedule.current_planned_end=2026-10-27, reason 'Подрядчик перенёс срок (R10)') -> public detail still 2026-10-20 (working copy) -> publish(reason 'Публикация переноса') -> public history entry {changed_fields:[schedule.current_planned_end], reason:'Публикация переноса'}
observations.expected: Product criterion (prompts/R10): житель видит объяснение изменения. CONTRACT §1 history has one reason per entry and does not say whose reason a published change shows.
observations.actual: The update reason stays only in staff history; residents see whatever the publish reason says.
observations.recommendation: Either carry update reasons of public fields into the public entry (e.g. joined), or make R04 prefill/require the publish reason from the pending change; document in R01 contract_delta.

integration_risks.title: R01 gateway context keys differ from what R02 CivicService requires
integration_risks.detail: R02 refuses session/login/staff unless context['host_allowed'] is True and reads 'is_https' for the Secure flag; R01 cp2 sends host/scheme/secure but no host_allowed/is_https, and is_same_origin=False (not None) when Origin is absent. As-is, every login through R01 would be refused. Expected to be resolved by R01 during integration; R10 will re-test on R01's CODE_SHA.
